target_customer: African and emerging market businesses, importers and fintechs needing USD, EUR and GBP payments
problem: Businesses without USD access struggle to pay global suppliers and manage treasury and liquidity.
business_model: Payments platform: FX spread and transaction fees, later multi-currency accounts and trade finance (inferred)

founders.name: Maxwell Obi
prior_employers: Sendwave (Global Head of Business; acquired by WorldRemit)
education: Computer Science degree (institution not named on YC page)
previous_startups: Amplify (Nigeria fintech, acquired by Carbon in 2019)

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires banking rails, compliance and liquidity management across many corridors; engineering is standard fintech plus licensing.

defensibility.rationale: Holds US money services business registration and a VASP license (secondary report) and direct banking rails, but competitors like Cleva and Flutterwave exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; Mercury restricting African accounts in July 2024 created demand for Waza's Lync (Jan 2025).

market_need_then: African firms lacked USD access for trade payments; no dated 2023 spend figure found.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch, Techpoint, TechCabal style African tech press at the seed announcement.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Waza was built by founders with Sendwave, Revolut and African fintech backgrounds, came out of stealth in August 2024 with $8M ($3M equity and $5M debt), and launched the Lync multi-currency account in January 2025. No later round or exit was found.
notes: Pre-seed amount (more than $1.2M) comes from one article with no date; date left null. A claim of $700M annualized volume is from secondary reports and unverified. Founded year 2022 per YC page; one source says January 2023. No competitor list dated near the batch was found; searches returned only 2025 to 2026 vendor comparison pages, which are not valid as of founding. Name origin not found.
